## Checks

- [ ] Reproduced first (failing test, log or measurement) and fixed at the root cause.
- [ ] Tested on real devices if it touches Bluetooth, codecs, audio, streaming or lifecycle, with the same settings before and after.
- [ ] Docs updated in the one document that owns the fact.
- [ ] The diff contains no private data (serials, Bluetooth addresses, keys, personal names, private paths, other people's media).
- [ ] Substantial AI assistance is disclosed here (which tool, for what), and I have read and run everything it wrote.
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`).
